guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Loyalty Dashboard
guide.description: Open the Beldex Loyalty Program and connect an EVM wallet. Your points and rank attach to that address, so use a wallet you intend to keep.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Link Your X Account
guide.description: Connect X from the dashboard before starting tasks. Rewards do not pay out without an X connection, and the same applies to anyone you refer.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Clear the Community Tasks
guide.description: One-time actions that you need to complete from the airdrop page that cover most of your opening balance: Follow Beldex on X (100 points) Follow Beldex on LinkedIn (100 points) Join the Discord server (100 points) Subscribe to the YouTube channel (100 points) Join the Telegram community group (50 points) Join the Telegram announcement channel (50 points) Join the X Community (50 points)
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the Limited-Time and Collab Tasks
guide.description: The dashboard rotates timed partner tasks, usually a follow or a like. Some run for days, others expire in under eight hours, so clear them on sight.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Post About Beldex on X Daily
guide.description: Write a post about Beldex, tag @BeldexCoin, then paste the link into the Submit Post field. This pays 20 points and resets every 24 hours. Spam risks rejection, so write about a product or update you have used.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check In Once Per Week
guide.description: The weekly check-in pays 20 points and resets every seven days. One click, and skipping it is the easiest way to leak points over a long campaign.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Generate Your Referral Link and Invite Friends
guide.description: Use the Get My Referral Link button. You earn 20% of your direct referrals’ earnings plus 5% from anyone they refer, and each friend gets 100 XP for signing up through you. Credit takes 24 to 48 hours, and referred accounts must connect X first.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
